findings.summary: synchronous_commit=remote_apply waits for standby while the singleton FOR UPDATE transaction remains open; the I13 no-remote-I/O condition is not fully closed.
findings.minimum_resolution: Commit locally durably, release SQL locks, then wait for observer/standby WAL fence before DECISION_COMMIT or effects; retain UNKNOWN_COMMIT and fencing recovery.

findings.summary: ADMISSION_SLOT has no witness-enforced expiry or specified cancellation proof/CAS for a missing or ambiguous SAMPLE acknowledgement.
findings.minimum_resolution: Add a finite monotonic slot deadline and atomic one-use PENDING-to-SAMPLE_RECORDED/CANCELLED then SAMPLE_RECORDED-to-DECISION_COMMIT/SAMPLE_ABORTED transitions; resolve ACK uncertainty by operation_id/head and keep the gate closed when absence cannot be proven.

findings.summary: SPEC 0190 still describes I11 acceptance on the old c334… hash and says a new critique is satisfied, while SPEC 0162 requires I14 and T3 reapproval.
findings.minimum_resolution: Reconcile the 0190 status in its owning claim before the next gate; it was read-only and not edited here.

i13_closure.P1_decision_at_in_external_highwater: CLOSED_DOCUMENTARILY: DECISION_COMMIT.decision_at is in external_max, the SQL marker/revision update is atomic, and one pending slot blocks the next serving SAMPLE until its receipt.
i13_closure.P2_remote_receipt_io_under_row_lock: PARTIALLY_CLOSED: observer/witness/verifier calls are outside SQL locks, but synchronous remote_apply remains inside COMMIT while row locks are retained.
i13_closure.rollback_and_unknown_commit: FAIL_CLOSED_DOCUMENTED: witnessed SAMPLE is preserved through SAMPLE_ABORTED and reconciliation; UNKNOWN_COMMIT retains slot/gate pending operation_id readback and receipt.
i13_closure.guard_revision: DECISION_AND_RECONCILIATION_INCREMENT_ONCE; BOOTSTRAP_STARTS_AT_ZERO; BREAK_GLASS_NEW_EPOCH_STARTS_AT_ZERO; receipts/claims bind epoch and old/new revisions.

protocol_review.highwater_reconciliation: The specified maximum includes baseline, SAMPLE, RECONCILE_SAMPLE, DECISION_COMMIT.decision_at, SAMPLE_ABORTED and RECOVERY_REBASE; reconciliation is tuple-fenced and cannot lower the marker.
protocol_review.bootstrap_ha_break_glass: Detailed fail-closed contracts exist for virgin/legacy bootstrap, legacy quiet window, HA fencing/WAL recovery, and two-phase break-glass rebase; operational independence and execution remain unproven.
protocol_review.transactions_and_grants: SECURITY DEFINER ownership, runtime restrictions, trigger claims, RLS, and external receipt ordering are specified; P2-01 remains.
protocol_review.markdown: No structural Markdown defect found by inspection; the 0190 state drift is recorded as P3.

performance.required_profile: 64 req/s open-loop; five 300-second runs after 60-second warmup; p99 <= 800 ms; decision confirmed <= 1 s; zero loss/error/timeout.
performance.judgment: Plausible but tight. A single serialized slot must sustain average end-to-end slot occupancy strictly below 15.625 ms to avoid queue growth. The specified 2 ms +/- 0.5 ms links do not prove that sequential slot, SAMPLE, SQL/replication, and DECISION_COMMIT steps meet the target. No load test or measurement was run.

residual_dependencies: Independent controller, observer, witness/WORM quorum, verifier/HSM, sink, identity registry and fencing authority are specified but not demonstrated.
B3 pending-event reconciliation/handoff, D-06 retention, provider idempotency, root/PR-L04 integration, CI/attestation and staging remain open under SPEC 0160.

authorization.next_gate: Resolve both P2 findings, update and hash the exact candidate, obtain a fresh independent critique, then explicit human T3 approval bound to the accepted hash.
